versions.subject: Sideloading DLL with space path
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows \'
        - 'C:\Program Files \'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86) \'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.dll'
condition: selection
